# Martin Gawlak Company

> A marketing company (marketing, IT and cybersecurity for small to medium sized companies) based in Fort Pierce and Sarasota, Florida, and the home of the Martin Gawlak Company family of brands.

The family of brands, each its own site:

- [Bandturo](https://bandturo.com/): tour booking by crowdfunding; ticket money waits in escrow until the show happens.
- [DayorDollar](https://dayordollar.com/): an art-coin launchpad on Zora with an open treasury.
- [Gawlak Family Farms](https://gawlakfamilyfarms.com/): permaculture gardens installed and kept on your property, Fort Pierce.
- [Baby Zora Gawlak](https://babyzoragawlak.com/): a play page that asks "who are you today?"
- [Fort Pierce Purple Martins FC](https://fppm.us/): Fort Pierce's soccer club.

Accounts: one sign-in for every brand site, at https://accounts.martingawlakcompany.com/, by email code or Google.

- [Martin Gawlak Company](https://martingawlakcompany.com/): The home page and the family of brands.

- [Alpha Mason](https://martingawlakcompany.com/alpha-mason/): Website development, social media, SEO, email and text marketing, social and Google ads, and analytics reports for $500 a month.
- [Pricing](https://martingawlakcompany.com/pricing/): Itemized pricing for marketing services.
- [Marketing Strategies](https://martingawlakcompany.com/marketing-strategies/): Strategies and case studies: SEO, Google Ads, Facebook Ads, traditional media, storytelling.
- [Marketing Terms](https://martingawlakcompany.com/marketing-terms/): Marketing terms defined.
- [Marketing Library](https://martingawlakcompany.com/marketing-library/): Marketing hacks, strategy and small-business advice.
- [Expert Perspective](https://martingawlakcompany.com/expert-perspective/): The podcast, on Spotify, YouTube and other platforms.
- [New Partner](https://martingawlakcompany.com/new-partner/): How a new partnership starts.
- [Shop](https://martingawlakcompany.com/shop/): Gawlak Family Farms decks and more.
- [The Rainbow Gun · $GAWLAK](https://martingawlakcompany.com/rainbowgun/): The $GAWLAK Family Bank, on Base.
- [Staff](https://martingawlakcompany.com/staff/): The team.
